title: Charming Modern Tudor in Historic Belmont
description:
Brightwood Guest House, a quiet, cozy retreat located between Vanderbilt, Belmont, & Lipscomb Universities is a 10-15 minute walk to coffee shops, restaurants, boutiques, groceries & all the fun of 12South, Hillsboro Village, & Belmont, & a 12-minute car ride Downtown. Enjoy all Nashville has to offer in this relaxing, private getaway in a historic neighborhood. Whether you're looking to relax on the deck, ride downtown for dining & music, or read a book in the loft, we've got your place!

The space
The Brightwood Guest House is a detached dwelling with an apartment above the garage. The apartment has 2 comfy beds: a king in the bedroom and a queen in the open loft. Up to 4 guests may enjoy the guest house and private deck with a fenced-in sitting area. Keyless entry. Parking for ONE car in the guests’ own garage. The washer and dryer are located in the garage for guests' use only. Fast wi-fi and Ethernet furnished.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire guesthouse apartment above, and the garage below for ONE car. The washer and dryer are located in the garage. The fenced-in side yard and the deck have an outside table with two chairs for guests’ use only.

Other things to note
The second queen size bed in the open loft in the living room is accessible by climbing the ladder up to the 9ft loft. Not recommended for children under 12..

Kitchen includes: dishes, bowls, glasses, wine glasses, silverware, cutlery, pots, pans, extra blankets, complimentary snacks, wine, beer, and more.
